Vacancy I.D.: 042765 - Assistant Lecturer/Lecturer in Civil Engineering (Permanent) Contract : Permanent Salary :  The gross salary scale applicable to the grade of Assistant Lecturer is €47,572 - €64,372 p.a. and the gross salary applicable to the grade of Lecturer is €69,625 - €107,727 on a whole-time basis (rates effective 01/06/2026). SETU wishes to appoint a Lecturer / Assistant Lecturer in Civil Engineering to join the Department of Built Environment. The grade of appointment (Assistant Lecturer or Lecturer) will be determined by the qualifications and experience of the successful candidate. The post holder will play an active role in the academic direction of the civil engineering programmes, including teaching, research, academic assessment, and academic administration. The role is a broad one: the post holder will be assigned a range of modules across both civil engineering programmes, from first-year foundation modules through to final-year design, project, and dissertation modules, in line with their expertise and the needs of the Department. Indicative teaching areas include structural analysis and design; geotechnical engineering and engineering geology; water, hydraulics and environmental engineering; highways, road design and traffic engineering; surveying, engineering drawing and BIM; materials, concrete and civil engineering technology; quantity surveying, economics and management; engineering mathematics and science; and project/dissertation supervision. A fuller list of the modules in these areas is set out in Appendix A. Candidates are not expected to cover every area; module allocation will reflect the appointee’s specialism(s), with a willingness to contribute across related modules as required. Teaching and learning on the programmes combine lectures and tutorials with laboratory and practical work, drawing and computer-based classes, surveying fieldwork, group and individual projects and continuous assessment. Several modules require students to engage fully in practical work and project work in order to meet the learning outcomes. Assistant Lecturers progress to the grade of Lecturer in accordance with SETU’s progression arrangements (including minimum service requirements and, normally, an appropriate postgraduate qualification or equivalent). SETU is an equal opportunities employer. #SETU

Vacancy I.D.: 042784 - Assistant Lecturer/Lecturer in Quantity Surveying (Fixed Term, 2 Years) Contract : Fixed Term, 2 Years Salary :  The gross salary scale applicable to the grade of Assistant Lecturer is €47,572 - €64,372 p.a. and the gross salary applicable to the grade of Lecturer is €69,625 - €107,727 on a whole-time basis (rates effective 01/06/2026). SETU wishes to appoint a Lecturer / Assistant Lecturer in Quantity Surveying to join the Department of Built Environment. The grade of appointment (Assistant Lecturer or Lecturer) will be determined by the qualifications and experience of the successful candidate. The post holder will play an active role in the academic direction of the Quantity Surveying and Construction Management programmes, including teaching, research, academic assessment, and academic administration. The post is primarily a quantity surveying post, with a core teaching load in measurement, costing, estimating, cost control, building and design economics, procurement and contract law and valuation, supplemented by modules in construction technology, planning and management, health and safety, BIM and professional practice. The post holder will be assigned modules across the three programmes above, in line with their expertise and the needs of the Department. The Department is seeking applicants with a professional quantity surveying background (PQS). A candidate who is a Chartered Quantity Surveyor, or who holds professional membership of the Society of Chartered Surveyors Ireland (SCSI), the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (RICS) or an equivalent body, and who has practised in consultancy, contracting or the public sector, will be well placed to bring current professional practice into the classroom and to support the professional standing of the programmes. Indicative teaching areas include measurement and quantification; estimating, tendering and cost control; design and building economics; contract law, procurement and construction law; construction technology and building services; contract management and planning; construction health and safety; BIM and measurement software; professional practice; research methods; and dissertation supervision. A fuller list of the modules in these areas is set out in Appendix A. Candidates are not expected to cover every area; module allocation will reflect the appointee’s specialism(s), with a willingness to contribute across related modules as required. Teaching and learning on the programmes combine lectures and tutorials with measurement and costing exercises, drawing and BIM/computer-based classes, site and surveying practicals, group and individual projects and continuous assessment. Assistant Lecturers progress to the grade of Lecturer in accordance with SETU’s progression arrangements (including minimum service requirements and, normally, an appropriate postgraduate qualification or equivalent). Vacancy I.D.: 042704 - Examination Invigilator Part Time Panel - Waterford Campus Contract :  Casual, Part-Time hourly basis during examination periods Salary :  €15.96 per hour gross South East Technological University are currently accepting applications and following the recruitment process a panel of examination invigilators will be formed for the SETU Waterford Campus. This panel may be called on for examination sessions in Semester 1 & 2 (December/January and May), and Repeats (August) as required. Ordinarily, the panel will operate for a period of 2 years, unless exhausted prior to the end date. On behalf of the University, Examination Invigilators are responsible for overseeing the smooth and efficient running of examinations.  The role of Invigilator would suit someone who has the confidence to enforce the University regulations and to deal effectively and promptly with any problems that present themselves during the examination. The Invigilator must ensure that all policies and procedures pertaining to examinations are rigorously adhered to. Invigilators are required to complete various reports and registers. These are kept as the official record of attendance and any events during the examination. Accurate record keeping is therefore essential. New invigilators will receive training and are placed with experienced Invigilators for on the job training. Invigilators are employed on a casual part-time basis during examination periods. NOTE : Current students and/or staff of the University are ineligible to apply. For candidates who are successful in being panelled following the recruitment process, it will be a condition for appointment that they are not beyond the compulsory retirement age relevant to their date of first recruitment to public/civil service. SETU aims to ensure growth in education provision and enhanced research opportunities, as well as transformative community and industry engagement across the South East of Ireland and beyond. The Governing Body of SETU has been established in accordance with the provisions of the Technological Universities Act 2018 and the Higher Education Authority Act 2022. The functions of the Governing Body are identified in the relevant legislation. The University Internal Audit Function derives its authority from the Governing Body via the Audit & Risk Committee. The Internal Audit function is also expected to support colleagues, management and Audit & Risk Committee by providing assurance reports, recommendations, advice and assessments on matters pertaining to governance, control and compliance. All work is subject to quality assurance review, as directed by the Senior Internal Auditor. In order to meet the requirements of the code of governance, and expand the remit of the internal audit function of the University, SETU is seeking to recruit an internal auditor to support the continuous improvement of corporate governance within the University. The main duty of the post is to assist the Senior Internal Auditor to carry out the University internal audit plan, in accordance with the internal audit charter and procedures.
